_comment: Images served from THIS site for panels that must match an arena not yet reflashed to the current production build. Same schema as the firmware repo's published manifest.json; `default` is always false here (the published catalog's default wins), `legacy: true` puts the entry in the Legacy section with its note as a caution, `fingerprint` is the CRC-32 of the first 64 KiB (what the controller's panel inventory 0xD1 reports). Remove an entry once no arena runs it.

artifacts.label: v0.3.1 — Legacy: fleet image before panel-fw-v1.3.0 (9014b5b, active-low EINT)
artifacts.note: The image the course arenas ran before panel-fw-v1.3.0. Use it only to make a replacement panel match an arena that has not been reflashed yet; otherwise flash the Production build.
